data.title: Bußgeldbescheid – speeding fine of €98.50
data.summary: The Stadt Musterau – Bußgeldstelle issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid, Az. BG-2026-052877) dated 18 May 2026 for exceeding the speed limit by 23 km/h on 30 April 2026. The total amount due is €98.50 and the offence will be entered with 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice for a speeding offence. You can accept it or file an objection (Einspruch) if you disagree, in writing or for the record at the Bußgeldstelle; the app will show the deadline based on the delivery date recorded on the enclosed Zustellungsurkunde. If you do not object by the deadline shown, the fine becomes final (Rechtskraft) and the total amount must then be paid within two weeks of that; unpaid fines can be enforced. If you want to contest the measurement or the point entry, consider getting advice from a traffic lawyer before the deadline.
